scope: Independent source review of root-authored generated owned-engine fixture, real/synthetic Qt integration tests and two CMake registrations. Own arithmetic implementation/tests are excluded from independent implementation credit; their CMake wiring only is reviewed.

resolved_findings.problem: Raw new Bridge had no owner; QVERIFY/QTRY early return could leak active worker/lease before fixture deletion.
resolved_findings.resolution: Stack QObject bridgeOwner declared after fixture owns Bridge; explicit slot delete unregisters child normally; all early-return paths now join before fixture teardown.

resolved_findings.problem: A queued Observed signal and rate-limited complete seed did not guarantee unfinished transfer if GUI delivery lagged.
resolved_findings.resolution: Cancel/delete rows use partialSeed=true. Exact final16384-byte piece is zeroed in source while metadata retains expected bytes; ready requires7/8 pieces and neither checking nor seeding. No other discovery/peer can provide final piece. Deletion name now accurately refers to unfinished transfer. Normal success fixtures remain full8/8.

resolved_findings.origin: Root first focused compile diagnosis, not independently discovered by this reviewer
resolved_findings.resolution: Final source checks parsedHash.has_value then assigns *parsedHash. Matches actual core parse signature; first failed build/log retained by root. No initial compile PASS is claimed.

checks.subject: Generated profile/privacy
checks.detail: Fresh QTemporaryDir owns every profile/active/state/payload/seed file. Both LT owners bind/outgo127.0.0.1; DHT/LSD/UPnP/NATPMP/UTP disabled, bootstrap empty, trackers cleared and PEX off. No Java, normal profile, DNS name, public peer or scan. Temporary root outlives seed and every scoped Bridge/lease owner.

checks.subject: Payload/hash geometry
checks.detail: 131072 deterministic nonzero bytes,8pieces of16384; single sample.bin or two65536-byte files under bundle/Sub. Piece SHA1s use exact concatenation; infohash SHA1 uses encoded info. Save/metadata paths match; sink starts zero; original payload device/inode retained. Last piece pattern is not all-zero, so the partial source cannot validate it. maxdl65536 is actual byte/sec policy, not the cancellation correctness gate.

checks.subject: Synthetic controller/cache checks
checks.detail: Independent packets reject unbound target/stale operation/profile/terminal sequence and preserve last facts through terminal/no sample and page close/reopen. Filter/column width/files target comparisons protect retained library state. These DTO cases are distinct from real loopback measurements.

checks.subject: Real observations/owner reset
checks.detail: Both layouts require Preparing, strict session/operation sequence, successful Ended/sample, positive payload<=physical bytes, combined>payload and positive measured combined rate. Samples structurally validate; actual payload bytes and inode/device must match and statistics stays unchanged. New final delta runs a second completed-file recheck, requires operation+1 and payloadReceived0, and verifies page displays actual new-owner zero instead of prior totals.

checks.subject: Cancel/delete lifecycle
checks.detail: Cancellation starts only after a real positive-payload sample with missing-finalpiece source; unsuccessful terminal retains displayed last-observed sample. Deletion runs from positive sample, QPointer must clear after destructor/join and a new lease is acquired afterward. Parent owner handles all test-assertion early returns. No complete byte content is asserted for intentionally cancelled payload.

checks.subject: Observer errors do not change transfer
checks.detail: Four real direct LocalOptions rows cover single/multi opted-out and throwing observers. They require actual success, exactly0/1 callback calls, full size/payload/device/inode/statistics preservation and retained opaque root bytes. No expected-output transition mirror or fake counters replace LT output.

checks.subject: Qt waiting/fixture teardown
checks.detail: Offscreen asserted. No sleeps: QTRY/qWaitFor poll actual ready/busy/packet/lease conditions with unchanged30s/3s. Scoped seed/Bridge/spies now tear down before generated root removal. Optional screenshot writes absent fixed PNG names only to caller-provided existing capture directory; no profile traversal.

checks.subject: Two CMake registrations
checks.detail: Core arithmetic target uses existing Core/strict warnings/30s. Real integration is desktop-gated (top level requires local engine), AUTOMOC and actual host+engine+LT+QtTest, strict warnings/offscreen/120s/owned-loopback labels. No skip return, deadline expansion, warning relaxation, mock engine or Java startup.

scope_precision: intact(false) intentionally checks payload device/inode rather than complete bytes.
Saved statistics compares raw bytes and absent .bak/.saving, not its original inode/mode. Entire profile is not unchanged because actual transfer updates state/download inventory.
Simple two-file geometry has no padding/DND/incomplete suffix; wider file-policy/crash/rename evidence is separate.
No exact final teardown byte receipt, full global/application lifetime, original Java equality or performance claim.
